name: @zhushanwen/pi-retry-rules
description: Retryable error rules for Pi — message_end rewrite triggers the native retry loop for throttling-class provider errors, with configurable rules (builtin baseline ⊕ remote overlay ⊕ user custom) and ReDoS-guarded matching.
